Title: Show 3D Pen (Avatar)

Note: When the Avatar is hidden, the lines and shapes are hidden as well.

Title: Edit 3D Garment Measure
Content: Objective Edit 3D Garment Measure. Location Main Menu 3D Garment Measurement Edit Garment Measure 3D Toolbar Edit Garment Measure Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Measurement Edit Garment Measure 3D Toolbar Edit Garment Measure Click on a 3D Garment Measure to edit. The selected 3D Garment Measure is now being highlighted. Its properties are now being appeared in the Property Editor. Modify the properties of 3D Garment Measure. Linear Garment Measure Circumference Garment Measure Name Rename the Linear Garment Measure. Name Rename the Circumference Garment Measure. Length Confirm the length of the Linear Garment Measure. Circle Diameter Modify the circle diameter that appears with the Circumference Garment Measure.

Title: Convert to Baseline
Content: Objective Convert Internal Lines to Baselines to utilize them as guidelines. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern Select Internal Lines/Shapes to be converted to Baselines. The selected Internal Lines/Shapes are highlighted in yellow. Right click on the selected Internal Lines/Shapes. The right click pop-up menu appears. Select Convert to Baseline. The selected Internal Lines/Shapes are converted to Baselines and they appear as purple.

Title: [2D Tool] 1:N Free Sewing
Content: Objective Freely establish Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Shapes/Lines to sew multiple Patterns to a single Pattern (ver2.2.0). Location Main Menu Sewing Free Sewing 2D Toolbar Free Sewing Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Sewing Free Sewing 2D Toolbar Free Sewing Establish the start and the end point on the Pattern outline, which is called as 1, where multiple Patterns are sewn to. Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard. The Sewing Line appears in neon color. While holding down the Shift key, establish Sewing Lines on N Patterns. Similar to setting regular Free Sewing Lines, be careful with Directional Notches. Release the Shift key to complete. Note While establishing 1:N Sewing Lines, if you click on an inappropriate segment, the segment appears in red and the Sewing Line cannot be applied. While establishing N Sewing Lines, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action or hit the Esc key on the keyboard to cancel all actions.

Title: [Object Browser] Apply Button Style
Content: List of Contents Apply Button Style In Property Editor Select A Button And Apply Button Style Select A Button And Apply A New Button Style Apply a Button Style by Drag-and-Drop Objective Apply button styles onto buttons as desired. Location Object Browser Button Tab Operation Apply Button Style In Property Editor Click on a button and select a button style in the Property Editor. The selected button style is now being applied to the button. Select A Button And Apply Button Style Select a button. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Tab Assigned to Selected Patterns The button style is now being applied to the selected button. Select A Button And Apply A New Button Style Select a button. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Tab Assigned to New Fabric A new buttonhole style is now being added to the buttonhole list window and applied at the same time. Apply A Button Style by Drag-and-Drop Drag and drop a new button style onto a button in the 3D Window. A new button style is now being added to the selected button.

Title: [Tool] Create Button
Content: List of Contents Create Button Input Measurement for Button Position Objective Create buttons and place them as desired. Location Main Menu Materials Button Button 3D Toolbar Button Operation Create Button Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Button 3D Toolbar Button Click on a desired point on the 3D Garment or 2D Pattern. A button is now being created at the designated location. Input Measurement for Button Position Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Button 3D Toolbar Button Right-click on the 2D Pattern where buttons would be placed. Moving Distance window appears. Input desired measurements for accurate placement. Placement preview depending on the input value displays along the mouse in the 2D window. Click OK to place. The buttons are now being created.

Title: [Popup] Add Point to Pattern on Start/End
Content: Objective Add point to Pattern outline on start or end point of a Sewing line. Location Main Menu Sewing Edit Sewing 2D Toolbar Edit Sewing Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Sewing Edit Sewing 2D Toolbar Edit Sewing Right click on the Sewing Line. The right click pop-up menu appears. At your need, add point to Pattern outline on either the start or the end point of the selected Sewing Line. The point is added respective to the chosen option. Note: The point is added to the Pattern outline where the selected Sewing Line is placed on. To add point to Pattern outline where the other half Sewing Line is placed, please repeat the same procedure above.

Title: [Tool] Fasten/Unfasten Button
Content: List of Contents Fasten Button Unfasten Button Objective Fasten or unfasten buttons to style the Garment as desired. Location Main Menu Materials Button Fasten Button 3D Toolbar Fasten Button Operation Fasten Button Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Fasten Button 3D Toolbar Fasten Button Click on a button, then click on its corresponding buttonhole in either the 2D or 3D environment, then continue on to the remaining buttons and buttonholes. The buttons move above the buttonholes. Lock icons next to the 3D buttons and buttonholes appear (ver2.5.0). Unfasten Button Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Fasten Button 3D Toolbar Fasten Button Click on fastened buttons and buttonholes in either the 2D or 3D environment. Buttons are now unfastened and return to their previous location. Lock icons next to the 3D buttons and buttonholes disappear (ver2.5.0). Note: To fasten multiple buttons and buttonholes at once, click and drag in the 2D window to select all buttons to be fastened, then click the first buttonhole to be paired with the buttons (ver4.0.0). To unlock multiple buttons and buttonholes, click and drag on all fastened buttons and buttonholes. Fastened buttons and buttonholes can now be moved (ver4.0.0).

Title: [Tool] Select/Move Button
Content: List of Contents Move Buttons with Click-and-Drag Move Buttons with Distance Input Objective Move buttons as desired. Location Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Operation Move Buttons with Click-and-Drag Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Click and drag the buttons to the desired location on either of 2D or 3D Pattern. The selected buttons are now being moved accordingly. Move Buttons with Distance Input (ver2.5.0) Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button While click and dragging the buttons with left-click mouse button, click right-click mouse button in either of 2D or 3D window. The Moving Distance window appears. Note: For the Mac OS version, click a Control key or F1 key. Enter desired value in the menu. Distance Moved Sets the moved distance of the buttonhole from its original location. Position Sets the position of the center of the buttonhole from the left/right/top/bottom of the Pattern outline. Click OK. The buttonholes are now being moved according to the input value. Note: It is able to select and move multiple buttons at once in the 2D window (ver2.4.0). The Gizmo for Select/Move Button tool has been changed from 2D rotation Gizmo to 3D translocation Gizmo (ver3.1.0).

Title: [Property] Flip Topstitch
Content: Objective Use the Flip function to set a Topstitch on an Internal Shape/Line in a different direction (inside and outside). Location Property Editor Placement Flip Operation Select a Topstitch with Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Placement Flip The Topstitch direction is now being changed.

Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curvature 2D Toolbar Edit Curvature Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curvature 2D Toolbar Edit Curvature Click and drag a straight line to convert it to a curved line. Title: Create an Avatar Fitting Suit (ver 7.3)
Content: Objective A fitting suit is an invisible component connected to an avatar that enables usage of the re-drape feature. CLO-native avatars include it by default, while it always has to be added for custom avatars. How to create a fitting suit: Location Main Menu Avatar Avatar Editor Fitting Suit Operation Load the object to create the fitting suit. Click the tool/menu indicated. Fitting Suit window appears. Create the circumference line on the avatar's position as the image. The pattern of the fitting suit is displayed. The circumference line on both sides are automatically created symmetrically. Note: You can create each by clicking the Symmetry button off at the top. After creating all circumference line, click the Drape Fitting Suit button. The fitting suit is draped. Note: When you click the Auto-Create Fitting Suit button, the fitting suit is automatically created on your avatar. At this time, if the avatar is not created properly, we recommend creating it manually. You can delete it by selecting the circumference line you want to delete from the avatar or by selecting the item in the fitting suit window and clicking the delete button. You can return to the initial state by clicking the reset button.

Title: Can you make patterns in CLO?
Content: Yes, we have intuitive pattern tools that can be used to generate patterns shapes from scratch.

Title: CLO Account Integration User Guide
Content: *This FAQ is intended for existing CLO users. Objective Access all CLO Virtual Fashion services using a single email account. This FAQ will cover the updates and changes to login methods for CLO Individual &amp Student license account types. This change will not affect Enterprise &amp Academic account types at this time. Please check the general FAQ if you have questions about the account merging process (CLO-SET accounts). Details 1) Change in login method Effective from the next released version, CLO 2024.0 What does this cover? CLO website / Software version 2024.0 and above Software Version (7.3 and below) Software Version Above 2024.0 How to login Existing License ID &amp Password CLO-SET ID &amp Password 2) How do I get a CLO-SET ID &amp Password if I have an existing CLO account? Check out our detailed step-by-step guide here. 3) What is the difference between a CLO-SET account and my previous CLO account? With your old CLO account you had to have multiple logins to access all of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services. Now with one CLO-SET account you can access all CLO Virtual Fashion services without additional logins. If you choose to login to the websites for any of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services you will be prompted to merge your account logins into a CLO-SET account. 4) How do I login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny after I merge my account? You can login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny with your CLO-SET ID &amp Password. 5) I have a subscription license for CLO and I like to use an older version than 2024.0. Do I have to use a different Log in or can I use the CLO-SET account? If you have an old installer on your device and you have access to versions below 2024.0: Use the older login method. Login to the installed version you wish to use with your License ID &amp Password (same as before) For 2024.0 and above: you can log in to all CLO Virtual Fashion product (CLO/Marvelous Designer/CONNECT/CLO-SET) websites and software with your CLO-SET account. 6) I have both CLO and Marvelous Designer accounts and I use them frequently. How does it affect me? You no longer have to use two separate logins! You can continue using your licenses without functional change for both CLO and Marvelous Designer. All you have to do is login with your CLO-SET account. You can check the license information for your products on the CLO or Marvelous Designer websites. 7) I like to use different email addresses for CLO and Marvelous Designer for my own reasons and want to keep them separate. Can I still have separate accounts? Yes, make sure to use the different email addresses for your CLO-SET merge so that you will have two separate CLO-SET accounts. The accounts are tied to each email address and the licenses associated with each account will be included in that merge. If you wish to unify your email addresses in the future or have other questions, please contact us by submitting a request. If you need assistance regarding accounts merging or have questions, please contact us by submitting a request, and our support team will promptly respond to your inquiry.

Title: Terms and Conditions of CLO for Entrepreneurs Incubation Program
Content: These terms and conditions govern your participation in the CLO for Entrepreneurs Incubation Program (Program) offered by CLO Virtual Fashion GmbH, located at Arnulfstrasse 58, 80335 Munich, Germany. 1. Eligibility 1.1 Participants must be entrepreneurial users who are in the process of starting, or have recently started, a new business or brand, and wish to integrate CLO software into their workflow. 1.2 The Program is exclusively available to individuals located within Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. By applying to the Program, you represent and warrant that you are a resident of one of those regions. 1.3 Participation in the Program is open only to new CLO users who are eligible for the Individual License as set forth in section 2.2.1 of CLO Additional Terms. This includes users who have never had an active CLO subscription before and who are hobbyists, freelancers, or sole proprietors. Existing Enterprise or Academic Users, and Individual Users eligible for the CLO plan for students, are not eligible for the Program. 2. Application period 2.1 Applicants must submit a complete application form by September 21, 2024. 2.2 Out of all applicants, five individuals will be selected to join the Program. CLO team will evaluate all submissions based on criteria including, but not limited to, potential, innovation, and originality. 2.3 Notification of the selected participants will be issued individually via email on Monday, September 30, 2024. 3. Program Benefits 3.1 Participants will receive a free annual individual CLO license for one year, free access to INTRO TO CLO - Basic Apparel Design course for three months, and a One-Hour Video Session with one of CLO's 3D specialists (if eligible). 3.2 CLO Virtual Fashion GmbH reserves the right to modify or terminate the benefits provided under the Program at any time. 4. Responsibilities 4.1 Participants agree to actively utilize CLO software, create a CLO-SET account and CLO-SET CONNECT portfolio, complete INTRO TO CLO - Basic Apparel Design course, and participate in the One-Hour Video Session offered by the Program, as stipulated by CLO Virtual Fashion GmbH. 4.2 To be eligible for participation in the One-hour Video Session, the participant must have successfully completed the INTRO TO CLO - Basic Apparel Design course prior to the scheduled session date. This story may be published on CLO website in blog format or on the official CLO YouTube channel in video format. 4.5 Participants shall comply with the applicable terms and conditions in using the CLO license and access to INTRO TO CLO - Basic Apparel Design course provided for the purpose of this program. 5. Intellectual Property Any intellectual property developed during the CLO for Program will be owned by the creator(s), subject to the terms of a separate agreement to be negotiated in good faith. 6. Duration and Termination 6.1 The Program will commence on October 14, 2024, and will continue for a period of six months. 6.2 CLO Virtual Fashion GmbH reserves the right to terminate a participant's participation in the Program for violations of these Terms or for any other reason at its sole discretion. 7. Miscellaneous 7.1 These Terms constitute the entire agreement between the parties regarding the Program and supersede any prior agreements or understandings. 7.2 These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Germany. 7.3 By participating in the Program, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. Title: How do you fit 3D Garments in CLO?
Content: To check fit, create and drape 3D Garments first. Draft your own Patterns in CLO or import Patterns created in other 2D CAD software to CLO, and then sew and drape Patterns on an Avatar. For more accurate fitting process, please use the Attach to Avatar Tape function to align the 3D Garment's shoulder seams to the Avatar's shoulder line. Then, select the desired texture rendering style from Transparent Surface, Fit Map, Stress Map, and Strain Map, and use various types of Garment Measure to further examine the fit.

Title: Change Email from CLO-SET
Content: Objective Understand how to change your email address, and the following implications of changing your account email. Change Email vs. Email Switching Ground Rules for Change Email Change Email Guide General Flow Confirm License Info Change Email Implications Troubleshooting Details 1) Change Email vs. Email Switching Change Email VS Email Switch (when the 'new email' is already on CLO-SET) Change Email: Change your CLO-SET Integrated account email. Changing the CLO-SET email will also update the connected CLO license information if any. Please find instructions below on the Change Email Guide. Email Switch: Email Switching is for users hoping to connect their existing CLO license with a different CLO-SET email account. This feature is not available yet. For such requests, please submit a ticket. 2) Ground Rules for Change Email Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on CLO software cannot use 'Change email' feature. If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the troubleshooting guide for further steps. Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. 3) Change Email Guide 1. Click on the 'Change Email from CLO-SET' button on Account page and visit 'My page' on CLO-SET to start the change email process. 2. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. 3. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. Not receiving verification emails? 4. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. 5. [Important] Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. *Signing again with your current email (abc@clo3d.com) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to newemail@clo3d.com. *If you would like to keep the license under the current email (abc@clo3d.com), please use the 'Email Switching' feature instead. 4) Change Email Implications Impact on Request and Community HistoryChanging your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. Account TypeEnterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. Billing Email MatchingIf your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. Plan Type ConsiderationsIf you have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), you won't be able to proceed with the email change. You may need to retain your current email or consider cancelling your subscription to initiate the change.If you don't have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), your user type will automatically change with the email change. (IndividualStudent) However, be aware that this may impact the available subscription plans. Only plans corresponding to your updated user type will be available for purchase. Change Email between CLO global and China WebsitesWhen you change your email on the CLO Global website, you cannot change it to the email registered on the CLO China website. 5) Troubleshooting For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the Troubleshooting Guide to reach the support team. Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to Contact Us.

Title: How can I get a trial version of CLO?
Content: CLO offers a CLO free trial for 14 days, and all users eligible for an Individual license can use a one-time free trial. *Your paid subscription will automatically start right after the trial expires and you can cancel your trial before renewal, avoiding charges. Important Note: To receive the student discount, you must verify your student status before starting your trial. If you fail to do so, you will not be eligible for the discount. Does CLO offer student discounts? Eligibility for a CLO free trial CLO Trial License can be started via the subscription button on the CLO web and is strictly reserved for a hobbyist, freelancer, self-employed individual, or one person-company who qualifies for an Individual License according to our Terms of Service (2.2.1). *Enterprise and Academic entities must contact CLO Business Development Team via Contact Us separately to obtain the appropriate Trial License. Start your CLO free trial You must sign up first if you don't have a CLO account yet. Click the FREE TRIAL button on the main banner or at the top right side of clo3d.com or the 'GET STARTED' button on the subscription page. Choose the license plan. The chosen plan will get started after your trial expiration. Review your order, enter your billing address, and click the 'Continue' button. Enter your payment information on the final checkout page. Download a CLO installer and start your free trial. *if you have already downloaded the CLO trial version, you can go to the download page for a CLO installer.

Title: glTF 2.0 (GLTF/GLB) File
Content: List of Contents Import glTF 2.0 Export glTF 2.0 Extensions Objective Import or export glTF 2.0 (GLTF/GLB) files. Location Main Menu File Import/Export glTF 2.0 (GLTF/GLB) Operation Import Click the menu indicated in Location. The Open File window opens. Select the desired file and click OK. The Import window opens. Configure the settings and click OK. Option Description Open Type Open or add new files. Object Type Load as Avatar / Trim (ver 6.0) Load a GLTF/GLB file as an avatar / trim. Arrangement Points Auto Generate (ver 6.0) It automatically creates a Bounding Volume/Arrangement Points suitable for GLTF/GLB. Scale Type in the Scale or select the desired unit. Note: Commonly used default unit for GLTF file is Meter. Axis Conversion Invert each axis of the OBJ as needed. Export Select the menu/tool indicated in Location. The Save File window opens. Select the desired saving path and click Save. The Export window opens. Configure the settings and click OK. Option Description Object Select All Avatars/ Patterns/ Graphics/ Trims Select or deselect objects to be exported. Single/ Multiple Objects Export the object as a single or multiple objects. Unweld/Weld Choose to export vertex (points of mesh) of sewn pattern parts as multiple objects or a single point. Thick/Thin Choose to export the object with the thickness or not. Combined UV Coordinates A combined UV coordinates are also exported. Option Light (Except for Render Lights) Export along with lights Garment Animation (ver 6.1) Export garment's animation. Scale Select the unit or the size of the object. Note: Commonly used default unit for GLTF file is Meter. Axis Conversion Invert each axis of the OBJ as needed. File Save Colorway (ver 6.1) Choose whether you export colorway or not. Combine to One File/Multiple Files (ver 6.2) Choose whether you combine all colorways into one file or create separate files for each colorway. Save with glTF-Embedded (GLTF Only) Save textures as the glTF-Embedded format which includes texture files. Save with Zip Files (ZIP) Diffuse Color Combined on Texture When color is applied to the texture, the color is blended into the texture when exporting. Note: Since the color is diffused to the UV map when the Combined UV Coordinates is selected, the menu is hidden. Exclude Ambient Map &amp Color (Modo) Ambient Map and color are excluded when exporting.. Note: 'Since ambient maps and color are automatically excluded, the menu is hidden. Save with MetaData (XML) Save garments' patterns (mesh), physical properties, and sewing information as MetaData (XML). Extensions Property Description Required Reflection Factor Reflection intensity of PBR material. In CLO, it has defaulted 15(0.15). Other engines and SW is defaulted 100(1.0) like the real world. No, Default: 1.0

Title: Garment Fit Maps

Title: I have a verification issue. What should I do?
Content: Please use Chrome instead of other internet browsers. CLO website is optimized as Chrome. [CASE 1] If you didn't receive the verification email, please check your spam mailbox. Sometimes the verification email can be found in your spam folder, or you will need to refresh your browser. [CASE 2] If CLO web requires verification, even if you already verify it, please remove your old cookie and cache. In Chrome On your computer, open Chrome. At the top right, click More. Click More tools. Clear browsing data. At the top, choose a time range. To delete everything, select All time. Next to "Cookies and other site data" and "Cached images and files," check the boxes. Click Clear data. [CASE 3] Some school domains block external emails. If so, you can check your school domain is connected to the verification email on Verify Email Address Link. If you see the result as "Connecting did not work", please ask your school admin (especially the technical division) to check if you could receive the verification email from the domain "clo-set.com". If you still have not received your verification email, please reach out to CLO via Contact Us.

Title: Deactivate CLO from website
Content: Applicable for: 5.0 and later CLO product type: StandAlone Onlineauth only Deactivation means deactivating the CLO of the previous device to access the CLO from another device. Therefore, deactivation does not cancel your trial and paid subscription. Problems Worked with CLO on the office computer and try to log in to CLO with a home computer, it says that it is already in use. Tried to log in CLO on a new computer, it says that another computer is already in use. Worked on the desktop, and tried to log in to the laptop, it says that it is already in use. How to deactivate 1) Log in to the CLO website. https://www.clo3d.com/ 2) Select the profile icon at the top right and then select "Subscription". 3) Click the "License Details" button. 4) Click the "Remote Logout" link next to the subscription title. 5) Try to access CLO software on a new device again. Read more If you exit by selecting "Log out" or "Deactivation" in the CLO software, the Deactivation button will not appear on the CLO website. Depending on the region, network, and CLO server status, there may be a delay in which the Deactivation button is displayed. (Up to 15 minutes)

Title: I cannot log in. What should I do?
Content: Please follow the instructions below based on your subscription plan and software authentication for Business Plan Clients to solve the login issue. CLO for Individuals Please use the Chrome browser over other browsers and remove the old cookies. Check your user ID and Password (User ID and PW you set up when signing up clo3d website.) -For signing in to CLO software, the user ID is your email address above CLO 2024 version, or the name on your account page or receipt below 2024 version. -If you receive the user ID as your email address, please install CLO software with 2024 version via the download page and access CLO software through 'sign-in with CLO-SET'. -Please check your user ID from your subscription invoice as some users are confused with other CLO accounts. If the PC's 443 port firewall is blocked, unblock and try logging in again. Deactivate the antivirus program on the PC and try logging in again. If the above steps do not solve your problem, please reach out via Contact Us. CLO for Business Users Standalone Check the dongle key is connected to the PC, and try logging in again. Check the HASP Driver is properly installed, and try logging in again. Confirm internet connection. Confirm ID and Password. If the PC's 443 port firewall is blocked, unblock and try logging in again. Deactivate the antivirus program on the PC and try logging in again. If the above steps do not solve your problem, please reach out via Contact Us. Network Check the dongle key is connected to a PC in the same network service, and try logging in again. Check the HASP Driver is properly installed on the PC, and try logging in again. Check your computer is in the same network service as the PC with the dongle key. If your computer is not in the same network service, select port forwarding and try logging in again. OnlineAuth Confirm ID and Password. If the PC's 443 port firewall is blocked, unblock and try logging in again. Deactivate the antivirus program on the PC and try logging in again. If the above steps do not solve your problem, please reach out via Contact Us.

Title: How do I download the installer?
Content: *Before downloading, you must purchase the license or try a free trial. If not, you cannot access the software. *Users who created a CLO account as of March 19th, 2024 can only download version 2024.0.1 or higher installers. CLO for Individuals To download an installer by version: Sign in and navigate to the Download Page on the footer. You must use 'Sign in with CLO-SET' for the 2024.0.1 installer or above. You can find the download buttons for PC or MAC (the latest version) if you have an active subscription. You can also click 'CLO Installer' for the old version. Select the Standalone Onlineauth tab for Individual licenses. CLO for Enterprise and CLO for Academic Institution To download the installer: If you want to get the installer download link for Enterprise/Academic Institutions, please contact us. Our business development team will provide you with more information.
